value.rationale: The 10-vertex Petersen graph is a canonical cubic non-bipartite graph of girth five. Four-state excitable dynamics supplies a mathematically natural additional refractory stage relative to the well-studied q=3 case, and threshold two is the first nontrivial local contact change on this graph. The exact period-five survival with three geometric orbit types and an 11-step transient, followed by universal five-step extinction under one threshold change, is a meaningful complete finite-dynamical classification and all-state benchmark beyond known three-state and tripartite formulas. No paper-sized or arbitrary-graph extrapolation is asserted.
